long_description: Lucis is a Paris-based preventive healthcare startup founded in 2025, backed by Y Combinator. The company focuses on enhancing human longevity by providing AI-driven health insights across Europe. Lucis operates as an educational and preventive health companion, bridging clinical-grade laboratory data with actionable lifestyle advice. Its mission is to make preventive health the standard for individuals in Europe. The core offering is a subscription-based preventive health companion app that integrates clinical testing with AI analysis and personalized health planning. Users can access a wide range of blood biomarker analyses, receive tailored health action plans, and benefit from ongoing health tracking. Lucis has already served over 10,000 customers and conducted more than 1 million biomarker tests, demonstrating significant early traction in markets including France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, and Portugal. The company aims to empower individuals to take proactive steps toward their health and well-being.

long_description: Medefy Health is a mobile-first healthcare benefits navigation platform based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Founded in 2018 or 2019, the company focuses on helping employers, insurance brokers, third-party administrators, and public organizations guide health plan members to the right care at the right time. Medefy combines a highly rated mobile app with 24/7 live Care Guides to enhance member engagement, lower healthcare costs, and improve health outcomes. The platform features real-time guidance from human experts, allowing users to connect via in-app chat or text. Medefy’s app consolidates health plans, vendors, and care programs into a single digital experience, helping members understand their benefits and make informed healthcare decisions. The company serves over 1,500 employer clients across all 50 U.S. states, targeting self-insured employers, healthcare intermediaries, and public organizations. Medefy aims to simplify access to health benefits and empower members to utilize their plans effectively.
